name: Pika
description: In Pika's Sparkle build, Info.plist enables automatic checks, points to https://superhighfives.com/releases/pika, and embeds SUPublicEDKey. The Sparkle AppDelegate path sets that feed and calls SUUpdater.shared().checkForUpdates; the reviewed source supports a configured EdDSA update trust key for this build variant.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Sparkle framework enforcement, feed contents, and shipped artifact signatures were not independently audited, and the evidence applies to TARGET_SPARKLE rather than the MAS variant.
